entries.text: Fixed TPC-Havoc variant 9_v7 returning groups with no matching rows on ClickHouse, variant 2_v10 returning no rows on Spark because a CASE-wrapped comparison of a CHAR column lost its padding, and variant 2_v7 failing on Velox because it rejects FILTER on window aggregates.
Fixed TPC-DS OBT queries 36, 45, 70 and 86 failing on LakeSail Sail because it cannot plan a CASE over a ROLLUP alias in ORDER BY or an IN subquery under OR.
